weaknesses: The abstract misrepresents the focus on CRISPR-Cas9 instead of the intended topic of tool usage in LLMs.
Claims regarding the novelty of the MetaTool benchmark are overstated; similar benchmarks exist without proper acknowledgment.
The scope described in the abstract does not align with the actual contributions, particularly in the evaluation of tool awareness.
strengths: The paper provides a comprehensive dataset, ToolE, which addresses the issue of overlapping tool functionalities.
The empirical analysis of LLMs' performance on tool usage awareness is thorough and highlights significant gaps in current models.
